algorithm: Parse JSON body when Content-Type is JSON and status is not 204.
Read error.message (always present on Auth error responses).
If error.details is present, bind field keys to form inputs.
Do not expect a top-level string error value.

401.meaning: Missing/invalid JWT, bad credentials, or unconfirmed sign-in attempt
401.client: Clear local session (except on the register-waiting screen) and route to sign-in.

403.client: Show message; do not clear session unless product requires it.

authMessages.unconfirmedSignIn: You have to confirm your email address before continuing.
authMessages.missingJwt: You need to sign in or sign up before continuing.
